subject.title: feat(slack): open group DMs from App Home

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin ship a native App Home MPIM opener that lets a DM-authorized creator create group-scoped agent access for selected Slack users?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and plugin-owned, but it changes a Slack access boundary and creates conversations/starter messages, which requires maintainer product and security-boundary intent rather than automation judgment.

options.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
options.body: Allow this feature if the PR keeps the existing DM/group-DM gates, clearly documents group-scoped access and no history transfer, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof before merge.

options.title: Require stricter member authorization
options.body: Ask for a revised design that checks selected members or adds an explicit opt-in policy before a creator can grant group-scoped access.

options.title: Keep docs/workarounds only
options.body: Do not add native MPIM creation now and continue directing users to private-channel conversion or external conversations.open usage.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
recommendation.body: Allow this feature if the PR keeps the existing DM/group-DM gates, clearly documents group-scoped access and no history transfer, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the current App Home and Slack interaction/gating code in current-main history, making them the best available decision owner for this boundary.
